aria: Animated recap of the 76ers' 111 to 87 win at Indiana: LeBron James's third three of the opening minutes with 8:54 left in the first that made it 15 to 5, quarter-by-quarter scoring, LeBron's 21 points, the top scorers, how the 76ers won, and the next game.

figure.label: LeBron James, listed 6-9, 250 lb (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia); no sourced wingspan

notes: Box score from Digest Sports' page for the 76ers' 111–87 win at Indiana on Nov 27, 2026: all 111 Philadelphia points and all 87 Indiana points add up from the player lines, as do the shooting totals (41 of 83, 15 of 37 from three, 14 of 17 FT for Philadelphia; 30 of 86, 5 of 37, 22 of 32 for Indiana). The final and the quarter scores (30–25–30–26 to 22–22–14–29) match the FOX Sports play-by-play's end-of-quarter scores; 55–44 at the half is also in the Philadelphia Inquirer and Field Level Media, and 85–58 after three in Bleacher Report. Rebounds (43–51), turnovers, points in the paint (44–48), fast-break points and points off turnovers (17–14) are from FOX Sports; assists (30–19) and blocks (5–1) from the Digest Sports box. Bleacher Report matches the LeBron, Embiid, Maxey, Simons, Barlow and Edgecombe lines. Philadelphia's biggest lead, 32 (104–72 with 6:57 left), is in Field Level Media and the FOX play-by-play; Indiana never led (AP, FOX). Records are from the AP and the site's standings after Friday's games.

LeBron James made three 3-pointers in the opening four minutes (AP) and had 11 points in the first quarter (AP) and 15 at the half (Inquirer). Indiana cut it to 39–38 in the second quarter before the 76ers closed the half on a 16–6 run (Metro Philadelphia; FOX play-by-play). Anfernee Simons made four threes in the last 3:06 of the third quarter for 12 straight Philadelphia points (Field Level Media; FOX play-by-play). Indiana's 5 of 37 from three was its fewest made threes this season (AP). Philadelphia won NBA Cup East Group B at 3–1 and reached the knockout round for the first time (Inquirer; NBC Sports Philadelphia; AP), and has won 7 of its last 8 (AP; Field Level Media). Joel Embiid returned after missing two games with an illness, Dominick Barlow made his first start of the season, and Jaylen Brown (hamstring) did not play (Inquirer; NBC Sports Philadelphia). Indiana was without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) for a 15th straight game (AP). The 76ers play at Houston on Saturday (AP).

The play of the game is an original illustration of LeBron James's three with 8:54 left in the first quarter, assisted by VJ Edgecombe, that made it 15–5: the FOX Sports and SI play-by-plays both have it at 8:54 for 12–5 to 15–5, after his threes at 11:11 and 10:41. So the board's 76ers +7 to +10 is 12–5 to 15–5. The shot's distance and the defender aren't recorded, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from the three-point line. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Philadelphia 76ers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to LeBron James's listed 6-foot-9 and 250 pounds (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia), with arms at the default length because no wingspan from an allowed source was found, in the 76ers' road kit with No. 23 (Wikipedia), with his proposed look from the site's look sheet. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
